core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Retail Pharmacy; Personal Care & Wellness; Laboratory & Diagnostics; Generics
specialty_focus: Pague Menos is a major Brazilian pharmacy retail chain that operates as an integrated health hub. It focuses on accessible specialty retail, offering brand-name and generic medicines, personal care, and wellness services through both physical stores and digital channels. Core Product Categories Prescription & Generic Medicines: Brand-name ("reference") drugs, generics, and specialized pharmaceutical medications.
